post.description: This endpoint validates e-file for a tax return across jurisdictions.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: A 4-digit alphanumeric identifier representing the client account. This must match the Account value provided in the request headers.

parameters.name: DeviceId
parameters.description: A 40-character alphanumeric string (case-sensitive, no separators) consisting of characters A–F and 0–9. This value must be generated using the SHA-1 hash algorithm and should include unique machine identifiers such as hardware serial number and UUID. Example: B495E04BA84A47AE2FAB21346A7BDAA6A3275EAA. Refer to the IRS publication at https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p1345.pdf for more details.

parameters.name: IpAddress
parameters.description: Valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

200.description: Success. The e-file validation is complete.

400.description:
Types of error in message:
- Missing account header: Message: "Please specify account information in header."
- Invalid tax type: Message: "Invalid Tax Return Type."
- Invalid jurisdiction: Message: "Invalid Jurisdiction(s) {wrongjurisdictions}."
- Account doesn't belong to firm: Message: "Account doesn't belong to firm."
- Locator doesn't exist: Message: "Locator not found."
- Missing IP address: Message: "Please specify IpAddress information in header."
- Invalid IP address: Message: "Invalid IP address."
- Missing device ID: Message: "Please specify DeviceId information in header."
- Invalid device ID format: Message: "Invalid Device ID format. Length of Device ID should be 40 characters. Allowed characters are A-F, a-f and 0-9."
- Exception during processing: Message: "Invalid Input {exp message}."

401.description: Indicates a lack of authorization to perform this action on this resource. Check credentials and rights.

500.description: Unexpected error encountered. Contact GoSystem Technical Support.

get.description: This endpoint downloads the generated e-file for a tax return. Prerequisite is e-file creation should be triggered using /v1/e-files or /v1/e-file-validations or via GoSystem.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The tax year for which the e-file is being processed. Must be a valid 4-digit year (e.g., 2024).

parameters.name: taxReturnType
parameters.description: Specifies the type of tax return being filed. 1040, 1041, 1065, 1120, 990, 5500, 709.

parameters.name: taxReturnId
parameters.description: A 6-digit unique alphanumeric identifier for the specific tax return. This is also referred to as the Locator ID.

parameters.name: jurisdiction
parameters.description: The state or local jurisdiction code where the tax is being filed. Example: AL for Alabama. Use the /v1/e-file-jurisdictions endpoint to retrieve valid codes.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: A 4-digit alphanumeric identifier representing the client account. This must match the Account value provided in the request headers.

200.description: Success. The e-file is downloaded.

400.description:
Types of error in message:
- Invalid input: Message: "Can't proceed with file download. Exception: Files aren't ready to download yet."
- Missing account header: Message: "Please specify account information in header."
- Invalid tax type: Message: "Invalid Tax Return Type."
- Locator doesn't exist: Message: "Locator not found."
- Invalid jurisdiction: Message: "Invalid Jurisdiction(s) {wrongjurisdictions}."
- Account doesn't belong to firm: Message: "Account doesn't belong to firm."
- Exception during processing: Message: "Invalid Input {exp message}."

401.description: Indicates a lack of authorization to perform this action on this resource. Check credentials and rights.

post.description: This endpoint retrieves e-file status by Tax Return or Taxpayer or Submitter or Account. Based on the query parameters, the e-file status can be returned.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Enter a valid 4-digit tax year (e.g., 2024) to view statuses for existing e-files.

parameters.name: Account
parameters.description: A 4-digit alphanumeric identifier representing the client account. This must match the Account value provided in the request headers.

parameters.name: EFileJurisdictionID
parameters.description: Add Jurisdiction ID if required.

parameters.name: EfileType
parameters.description: Add Efile type if required.

parameters.name: TotalRowsCount
parameters.description: Add Total rows count if filter is needed.

requestBody.description: Query by Tax Return or Taxpayer or Submitter or Account. The queries are mutually exclusive. Pass the valid values for the query for which you need to fetch the status. For other queries, pass null values. Queries will be executed from top to bottom, and result will be fetched for the first query with not null values.

200.description: Success. The e-file status is retrieved.

400.description:
Types of error in message:
- Year is greater than the current year: Message: "Invalid Year."
- Tax return type is invalid: Message: "Invalid Tax Return Type."
- Account header is missing when querying by account: Message: "Please specify account information in header."
- Account doesn't belong to the firm: Message: "Account doesn't belong to firm."
- Not enough input parameters: Message: "Not enough input parameters to process the request. Please pass either TaxReturn Or TaxPayer Or Submitter Or Account information."
- Any exception occurs during processing: Message: "Error fetching status - {exception message}."

401.description: Indicates a lack of authorization to perform this action on this resource. Check credentials and rights.

500.description: Unexpected error encountered. Contact GoSystem Technical Support.
